english.note: Use 培育 when deliberately developing animals or plants to produce improved varieties or qualities.

exampleSentences.english: We deliberately breed this kind of cat so the next generation will be healthier.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我哋專登培育呢種貓，等下一代更加健康。
